arabic text: THA YE BANO KA BAYAAN KIS KO DOON AB LORIYAN\nDHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text: This was Bano's lament: to whom shall I now sing lullabies?\nA mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?

arabic text: TERA JHOOLA JAL GAYA AEY MERE TISHNA DAHAAN\nDHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text: Your cradle has burned, O my thirsty child;\na mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?

arabic text:
KHOON BHARA KURTA TERA HAEY VO BHI CHIN GAYA
AB JIOUN KIS KAY SAHARAY PAAS MERE KYA RAHA
ZINDAGI HAI RAAEYGAAN UMR BHAR HOON NOHA KHAWAN
DHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text:
Your bloodstained shirt—alas, even that was taken away.
What remains for me, and by whose support shall I live?
Life is now meaningless; I will lament throughout my life.
A mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?

arabic text:
HAAEY WO NAZUK GALA TEEN DIN SAY KHUSHK THA
BHAR KAY MOJAY TEER NAY VO IS QADAR ZAKHMI KIYA
TAR HOUEE KHOON SAY ZABAAN LEY SAKAY NA HICHKIYAN
DHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text:
Alas, that delicate throat had been dry for three days.
The arrow struck it with such force,
and his tongue became drenched in blood before he could even gasp.
A mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?

arabic text:
KHAALI JHOOLA DAIKH KER AEY MERE NOOR-E-NAZAR
AANKH BHAR AATI HAI MERI AUR ROTA HAI JIGAR
SOGAEY HO TUM KAHAN CHAYN PAAEY KAISAY MAAN
DHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text:
Seeing the empty cradle, O light of my eyes,
my eyes fill with tears and my heart weeps.
Where have you fallen asleep? How can your mother find peace?
A mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?

arabic text:
JAAM ASHKON KAY PEEYO AAJ KI SHAB SO RAHO
UMR LAG JAEY HUMARI TUM KO TUM JEETAY RAHO
TUM PAY QURBAN MERI JAAN AEY QARAAR-E-BAY KASAAN
DHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text:
Drink the cup of tears and sleep tonight.
May our life be added to yours; may you remain alive.
My life is sacrificed for you, O comfort of the helpless.
A mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?

arabic text:
MEI MUSAFIR SHAAM KI KHATM HUD ARAAM KI
QAID HO KER JAA RAHI HOON GARD HAI ALAAM KI
BUND CHUKI HAI REESMAN HUM KAHAN ORE TUM KAHAN
DHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text:
I am a traveller towards Shaam; all rest has ended.
I go as a captive, covered in the dust of sorrow.
The ropes have been tied—where are we, and where are you?
A mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?

arabic text:
MEER KYA REHAN KYA JIS NAY YE NOHA SUNNA
ASHK ANKHON SAY BAHA KER US NAY RO RO KER KAHA
HAAEY AEY ASGHAR KI MAA UFF VO THERA IMTHIHAAN
DHOONDTHI PHIRTHI HAI MADER HAI MERA ASGHAR KAHAN
english translation text:
Whether Mir or Rehan, whoever heard this lament
shed tears from their eyes and cried:
alas, O Asghar's mother, what a trial you endured.
A mother wanders searching—where is my Asghar?
